findings: Planned a minimal fix that makes strict writing-helper acceptance a retained same-HEAD release signal. The solution emits a JSON acceptance artifact, adds a blocking `writing_helper_acceptance_signal` to `scripts/release_check_summary.py`, and hardens the contract with `delivery_gate.py`, `SIGN_OFF.md`, and governance tests. `check_authority_alignment.py` is intentionally left unchanged to minimize churn.
